top.titre: When News Gets Old: Portfolio Allocation with Reinforcement Learning and Large Language Models
top.extrait: Financial news can influence investment decisions long after publication. Timely news may reach an investor before prices fully adjust, whereas older news may already be reflected in prices.

top.titre: Simple Portfolios that Deliver Consistent Decent Returns
top.extrait: Portfolio construction has been studied extensively in both academia and industry. Its applications range from pension funds and hedge funds to private savings.

top.titre: Financial Context-Rich Strategy for Actor-Critic based Agents: A Deep Reinforcement Learning Approach for Stock Trading
top.extrait: In modern financial markets, more than 3/4th of the large volume trade is executed by algorithmic trading based on advanced trading strategies to attain higher precision and speed than traditional human traders. top.titre: Certifying Reward Alignment in Portfolio Reinforcement Learning
top.extrait: Financial reinforcement learning often translates an investment objective into an additive risk-adjusted reward. An agent can optimise that reward accurately yet implement a different financial preference.

top.titre: FinLLM-KG: Knowledge Graph-Enhanced LLMs for Financial Sentiment Analysis in Algorithmic Trading
top.extrait: Recent advances in Generative AI have substantially improved financial sentiment analysis through post-trained financial large language models (LLMs). However, existing approaches remain confined to predicting the sentiment of each article in isolation and operate as black boxes, which limits contextual understanding and hinders deployment in high-stakes financial decision-making.

top.titre: Weekend Crypto Volatility and Monday Market Risk
top.extrait: Cryptocurrencies trade continuously while major traditional markets close over the weekend. We examine whether weekend cryptocurrency volatility predicts Monday variance in equity, commodity and fixed-income markets.

top.titre: Cross-Bond Panel Learning for Next-Day Price Forecasting of Chinese Convertible Bonds: A Reality Check
deja_tranche: Famille RSI/MACD/Bollinger retail réfutée par 'Retail Trader's Ruin' (arXiv 2607.20093, lu le 29/07/2026) : Sharpe-gap et CAGR-gap significativement négatifs sur NASDAQ-100 et réplique UE.
top.extrait: Recent advances in financial machine learning have prompted growing interest in applying deep neural networks to convertible bond valuation and forecasting. However, existing studies often focus on in-sample valuation fit or cross-sectional return rankings, leaving out-of-sample next-day price forecasting insufficiently benchmarked against persistence.

top.titre: Governed Self-Evolution for Autonomous Investing: A Multi-Agent LLM System with an Invariant Core
deja_tranche: Famille RSI/MACD/Bollinger retail réfutée par 'Retail Trader's Ruin' (arXiv 2607.20093, lu le 29/07/2026) : Sharpe-gap et CAGR-gap significativement négatifs sur NASDAQ-100 et réplique UE.
top.extrait: LLM agents that act on live Web data must combine heterogeneous evidence, remember what they have done and improve from outcomes without weakening their own safeguards. We study this problem in autonomous investing, where every action is irreversible and based on untrusted Web content.
